_note: D2/D3: three passages (title only, title+author, text only). Expect synthesizing_sources present.
assignment_text: Using the sources, argue whether your town should limit cars downtown.

source_passages.title: A Car-Free Downtown
source_passages.text: Several European cities closed their centers to cars; air quality improved and foot traffic to shops rose.

source_passages.title: The Cost of Going Car-Free
source_passages.author: City staff
source_passages.text: Critics note delivery businesses and people with disabilities can be harmed when car access is removed without alternatives.
Downtown shops reported fewer customers in the first month after the pilot.

essay_text: Dear city council, our town should limit cars downtown, but carefully. Source 1 shows that when European cities closed their centers to cars, the air got cleaner and more people walked to shops. Source 2 warns that deliveries and people with disabilities could be hurt, so we would need loading zones and accessible shuttles. Source 3 says shops lost customers at first, but one month is too short to judge. If we plan for the groups in Source 2, the benefits in Source 1 are worth it.
